{{< include ../_provenance.qmd >}}

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(Seurat)
library(slingshot)
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(graphlayouts)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(ggrepel)
library(viridis)
library(ggridges)


theme_set(theme_cowplot(font_size = 11))

cond_pal   <- c(WT = "#888888", `mCh-` = "#2a9d8f", `mCh+` = "#e76f51")
cond_order <- c("WT", "mCh-", "mCh+")

label_condition <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("WT",      x) ~ "WT",
    grepl("mCh-",   x) ~ "mCh-",
    grepl("mCh\\+", x) ~ "mCh+",
    TRUE                ~ x
  )
}
```

# Overview

Trajectory inference for **mCh− Het** HSC cells using **Slingshot** (Street et al. 2018).
Cluster labels are transferred from the full-cohort clustering
(`sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9` on `mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc`).

| Step | Method |
|---|---|
| Graph backbone | MST on cluster centroids in PCA space |
| Curve fitting | Simultaneous principal curves per lineage |
| Pseudotime | Arc length along each fitted curve |
| Visualisation | UMAP coloured by pseudotime; per-cluster distributions |

---

# 1  Load data

```{r config}
# ── Trajectory parameters — edit this chunk only ──────────────────────────────
CLUS_COL        <- "sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9"  # cluster column (full-cohort)
N_PCA_DIMS      <- 15L
PCA_NAME        <- "pca.SCT"

EXCLUDE_CLUSTER <- c("16", "17", "20")
START_CLUSTER   <- "5"
END_CLUSTER     <- c("7", "4", "8", "6", "15", "0", "14", "13")
```

```{r load}
mpn_processed_hsc <- targets::tar_read(mpn_processed_hsc_mchneg_fullcc)
mpn_full          <- targets::tar_read(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
clus_meta         <- mpn_full@meta.data[, CLUS_COL, drop = FALSE]
# Full-cohort UMAP for condition cells — extracted before rm() for second overlay
umap_full_raw  <- as.data.frame(
  mpn_full@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings[colnames(mpn_processed_hsc), ])
umap_cols_full <- colnames(umap_full_raw)
rm(mpn_full); invisible(gc())
# Transfer full-cohort cluster labels; AddMetaData matches by cell barcode
mpn_processed_hsc <- Seurat::AddMetaData(mpn_processed_hsc, clus_meta)

# ── Cell and cluster vectors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
clus_all <- as.character(mpn_processed_hsc@meta.data[[CLUS_COL]])
names(clus_all) <- colnames(mpn_processed_hsc)

sling_cells <- names(clus_all)[!clus_all %in% EXCLUDE_CLUSTER]
clus        <- clus_all[sling_cells]
n_cl        <- length(unique(clus))

cat("Total cells:", length(clus_all), "\n")
cat("Excluded clusters:", if (length(EXCLUDE_CLUSTER)) paste(EXCLUDE_CLUSTER, collapse = ", ") else "none", "\n")
cat("Cells for inference:", length(sling_cells), "in", n_cl, "clusters\n")

# ── Embeddings (pre-filtered to sling_cells) ───────────────────────────────────
pca_emb <- Seurat::Embeddings(mpn_processed_hsc, PCA_NAME)[sling_cells, seq_len(N_PCA_DIMS)] |>
  as.data.frame()

umap_emb  <- as.data.frame(mpn_processed_hsc@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings)[sling_cells, ]
umap_cols <- colnames(umap_emb)

umap_df <- umap_emb |>
  dplyr::rename(umap1 = 1, umap2 = 2) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cluster   = clus,
    condition = label_condition(mpn_processed_hsc$sample.name[sling_cells])
  )

centroids <- umap_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) |>
  dplyr::summarise(x = median(umap1), y = median(umap2), .groups = "drop") |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("cluster")

# ── Full-cohort embedding coords (all condition cells; centroids from sling_cells only) ──
umap_df_full <- umap_full_raw |>
  dplyr::rename(umap1 = 1, umap2 = 2) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cluster   = clus_all[cell_id],
    condition = label_condition(mpn_processed_hsc$sample.name[cell_id])
  )

centroids_full <- umap_df_full |>
  dplyr::filter(cell_id %in% sling_cells) |>
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) |>
  dplyr::summarise(x = median(umap1), y = median(umap2), .groups = "drop") |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("cluster")
```

---

# 2  Run Slingshot

```{r slingshot-run}
set.seed(42)
sling_obj <- slingshot::slingshot(
  data          = pca_emb,
  clusterLabels = clus,
  #start.clus    = START_CLUSTER,
  end.clus      = END_CLUSTER,
  dist.method   = "scaled.diag",
  extend        = "n",
  allow.breaks  = FALSE)

n_lineages <- length(slingshot::slingLineages(sling_obj))
cat("Lineages detected:", n_lineages, "\n")
for (i in seq_len(n_lineages)) {
  cat("  Lineage", i, ":",
      paste(slingshot::slingLineages(sling_obj)[[i]], collapse = " → "), "\n")
}
```

---

# 3  Extract pseudotime

```{r pseudotime-extract}
sling_cell_df <- function(sling_ctr) {
  raw_pt <- slingshot::slingPseudotime(sling_ctr)

  pseudotime_df <- apply(raw_pt, 2, function(x) {
    x1 <- x[!is.na(x)]
    x[!is.na(x)] <- (x1 - min(x1)) / (max(x1) - min(x1)) * 100
    x
  }) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0("pseudotime_", .)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      mean_pseudotime   = rowMeans(dplyr::pick(dplyr::everything()), na.rm = TRUE),
      median_pseudotime = apply(dplyr::pick(dplyr::everything()), 1, median, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_pseudotime    = apply(dplyr::pick(dplyr::everything()), 1, max,    na.rm = TRUE),
      min_pseudotime    = apply(dplyr::pick(dplyr::everything()), 1, min,    na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  order_df <- apply(raw_pt, 2, function(x) {
    x[!is.na(x)] <- rank(x[!is.na(x)])
    x
  }) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0("order_", .)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(mean_order = rowMeans(dplyr::pick(dplyr::everything()), na.rm = TRUE))

  dplyr::bind_cols(as.data.frame(raw_pt), pseudotime_df, order_df)
}

sling_df <- sling_cell_df(sling_obj)
sling_df$cluster   <- clus[rownames(sling_df)]
sling_df$condition <- label_condition(mpn_processed_hsc$sample.name[rownames(sling_df)])

lineage_cols  <- grep("^pseudotime_Lineage", colnames(sling_df), value = TRUE)
lineage_names <- sub("pseudotime_", "", lineage_cols)

cat("Pseudotime columns:", paste(lineage_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Cells per lineage (non-NA):\n")
for (lc in lineage_cols) cat(" ", lc, ":", sum(!is.na(sling_df[[lc]])), "\n")
```

---

# 4  MST visualisations

## Tree layout (Reingold-Tilford)

```{r mst-tree}
g_mst    <- slingshot::slingMST(sling_obj)
mst_root <- if (!is.null(START_CLUSTER)) START_CLUSTER else
              V(g_mst)$name[which.max(igraph::betweenness(g_mst))]
cat("MST root:", mst_root, "\n")

set.seed(42)
rt_layout           <- igraph::layout_as_tree(g_mst, root = mst_root, flip.y = TRUE)
rownames(rt_layout) <- V(g_mst)$name
colnames(rt_layout) <- c("x", "y")

nodes_rt <- as.data.frame(rt_layout) |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cluster")
edges_rt <- igraph::as_data_frame(g_mst, what = "edges") |>
  dplyr::left_join(nodes_rt |> dplyr::rename(from = cluster, x_from = x, y_from = y), by = "from") |>
  dplyr::left_join(nodes_rt |> dplyr::rename(to   = cluster, x_to   = x, y_to   = y), by = "to")

ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = edges_rt,
               aes(x = x_from, y = y_from, xend = x_to, yend = y_to),
               colour = "steelblue4", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = nodes_rt, aes(x, y),
             shape = 21, fill = "steelblue4", colour = "white", size = 8, stroke = 0.8) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data = nodes_rt, aes(x, y, label = cluster),
                             size = 3, label.size = 0.2,
                             fill = alpha("white", 0.8), max.overlaps = 30) +
  labs(title = "Slingshot MST — Reingold-Tilford tree layout",
       subtitle = paste("Root:", mst_root)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10))
```

## MST overlaid on UMAP

### Condition-specific embedding

```{r mst-umap}
edges_umap <- igraph::as_data_frame(g_mst, what = "edges") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    centroids |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cluster") |>
      dplyr::rename(from = cluster, x_from = x, y_from = y), by = "from") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    centroids |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cluster") |>
      dplyr::rename(to   = cluster, x_to   = x, y_to   = y), by = "to")

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = umap_df, aes(umap1, umap2),
             colour = "grey88", size = 0.2, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(data = edges_umap,
               aes(x = x_from, y = y_from, xend = x_to, yend = y_to),
               colour = "steelblue4", linewidth = 1.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = centroids |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cluster"),
             aes(x, y),
             shape = 21, fill = "steelblue4", colour = "white", size = 5, stroke = 0.8) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = centroids |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cluster"),
    aes(x, y, label = cluster),
    size = 2.5, label.size = 0.2,
    fill = alpha("white", 0.75), max.overlaps = 30) +
  labs(x = umap_cols[1], y = umap_cols[2],
       title = "Slingshot MST — condition-specific UMAP") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
```

### Full-cohort embedding

```{r mst-umap-full}
edges_umap_full <- igraph::as_data_frame(g_mst, what = "edges") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    centroids_full |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cluster") |>
      dplyr::rename(from = cluster, x_from = x, y_from = y), by = "from") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    centroids_full |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cluster") |>
      dplyr::rename(to   = cluster, x_to   = x, y_to   = y), by = "to")

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = umap_df_full, aes(umap1, umap2),
             colour = "grey88", size = 0.2, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(data = edges_umap_full,
               aes(x = x_from, y = y_from, xend = x_to, yend = y_to),
               colour = "steelblue4", linewidth = 1.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = centroids_full |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cluster"),
             aes(x, y),
             shape = 21, fill = "steelblue4", colour = "white", size = 5, stroke = 0.8) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = centroids_full |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cluster"),
    aes(x, y, label = cluster),
    size = 2.5, label.size = 0.2,
    fill = alpha("white", 0.75), max.overlaps = 30) +
  labs(x = umap_cols_full[1], y = umap_cols_full[2],
       title = "Slingshot MST — full-cohort UMAP") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
```

# 5  Pseudotime UMAPs

## Mean pseudotime (all lineages)

```{r pt-umap-mean, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
pt_umap_df <- umap_df |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    sling_df |>
      tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
      dplyr::select(cell_id, mean_pseudotime, dplyr::all_of(lineage_cols)),
    by = "cell_id")

ggplot(pt_umap_df |> dplyr::arrange(is.na(mean_pseudotime))) +
  geom_point(aes(umap1, umap2, colour = mean_pseudotime),
             size = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Mean\npseudotime",
                         na.value = "grey88") +
  labs(x = umap_cols[1], y = umap_cols[2],
       title = "Mean pseudotime across all lineages") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        legend.position = "right")
```

## Per-lineage pseudotime

```{r pt-umap-lineages, fig.width=12}
#| fig.height: !expr ceiling(n_lineages / 2) * 6
plots_lin <- lapply(lineage_cols, function(lc) {
  lname <- sub("pseudotime_", "", lc)
  lin   <- slingshot::slingLineages(sling_obj)[[lname]]
  ggplot(pt_umap_df |> dplyr::arrange(is.na(.data[[lc]]))) +
    geom_point(aes(umap1, umap2),
               size = 0.35, alpha = 0.7, color = "grey90") +
    geom_point(aes(umap1, umap2, colour = .data[[lc]]),
               size = 0.35, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "viridis", name = "Pseudotime", na.value = NA) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
         title    = lname,
         subtitle = paste(lin, collapse = " → ")) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
          plot.subtitle     = element_text(size = 7, colour = "grey40"),
          legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"))
})

patchwork::wrap_plots(plots_lin, ncol = 2) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title = "Per-lineage pseudotime",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)))
```

## Slingshot principal curves on UMAP

```{r pt-curves, fig.width=12}
#| fig.height: !expr ceiling(n_lineages / 2) * 6
curve_dfs <- lapply(seq_len(n_lineages), function(i) {
  lc    <- lineage_cols[i]
  lname <- sub("pseudotime_", "", lc)
  pt_umap_df |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[lc]])) |>
    dplyr::mutate(lineage = lname, pseudotime = .data[[lc]])
})

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = umap_df, aes(umap1, umap2),
             colour = "grey88", size = 0.2, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = dplyr::bind_rows(curve_dfs),
             aes(umap1, umap2, colour = pseudotime),
             size = 0.35, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = edges_umap,
               aes(x = x_from, y = y_from, xend = x_to, yend = y_to),
               colour = "black", linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Pseudotime") +
  facet_wrap(~ lineage, ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = umap_cols[1], y = umap_cols[2],
       title = "Lineage cells coloured by pseudotime + MST backbone") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        legend.position = "right")
```

## Slingshot principal curves on PCA

```{r pt-pca-curves, fig.width=12}
#| fig.height: !expr ceiling(n_lineages / 2) * 6
curve_pca_dfs <- lapply(seq_len(n_lineages), function(i) {
  lc    <- lineage_cols[i]
  lname <- sub("pseudotime_", "", lc)
  crv   <- slingshot::slingCurves(sling_obj)[[i]]
  data.frame(PC_1 = crv$s[, 1], PC_2 = crv$s[, 2],
             PC_3 = crv$s[, 3], PC_4 = crv$s[, 4],
             PC_5 = crv$s[, 5], lineage = lname)
})

plots_pca_crv <- lapply(seq_len(n_lineages), function(i) {
  lc     <- lineage_cols[i]
  lname  <- sub("pseudotime_", "", lc)
  lin    <- slingshot::slingLineages(sling_obj)[[lname]]
  crv_df <- curve_pca_dfs[[i]]
  ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = pt_pca_df, aes(PC_1, PC_2),
               colour = "grey88", size = 0.2, alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_point(data = pt_pca_df |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[lc]])),
               aes(PC_1, PC_2, colour = .data[[lc]]),
               size = 0.45, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_path(data = crv_df, aes(PC_1, PC_2),
              colour = "black", linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.7,
              arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm"), type = "closed", ends = "last")) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Pseudotime", na.value = "grey88") +
    labs(x = "PC_1", y = "PC_2",
         title    = lname,
         subtitle = paste(lin, collapse = " → ")) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
          plot.subtitle     = element_text(size = 7, colour = "grey40"),
          legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"))
})

patchwork::wrap_plots(plots_pca_crv, ncol = 2) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title = "Slingshot principal curves in PCA space",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)))
```

---

# 6  Pseudotime distributions

```{r pt-long-build}
pt_long <- sling_df |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
  dplyr::select(cell_id, cluster, condition, dplyr::all_of(lineage_cols)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::all_of(lineage_cols),
                      names_to  = "lineage",
                      values_to = "pseudotime") |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(pseudotime)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(lineage   = sub("pseudotime_", "", lineage),
                cluster   = factor(cluster),
                condition = factor(condition, levels = cond_order))
```

## Per cluster × lineage

```{r pt-cluster-density, fig.width=12}
#| fig.height: !expr ceiling(n_lineages / 2) * 4
ggplot(pt_long, aes(x = pseudotime, y = cluster, fill = cluster)) +
  ggridges::geom_density_ridges(scale = 1.2, alpha = 0.7,
                                 linewidth = 0.3, colour = "white",
                                 rel_min_height = 0.01) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = scales::hue_pal()(n_cl), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  facet_wrap(~ lineage, ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = "Pseudotime (0–100)", y = "Cluster",
       title = "Cell density along pseudotime — per cluster") +
  theme(strip.text    = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
        axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 7))
```

## Per condition (genotype)

```{r pt-condition-density, fig.width=12}
#| fig.height: !expr ceiling(n_lineages / 2) * 3
ggplot(pt_long, aes(x = pseudotime, y = condition, fill = condition)) +
  ggridges::geom_density_ridges(scale = 1.1, alpha = 0.75,
                                 linewidth = 0.3, colour = "white",
                                 rel_min_height = 0.01) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cond_pal, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(cond_order)) +
  facet_wrap(~ lineage, ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = "Pseudotime (0–100)", y = NULL,
       title = "Cell density along pseudotime — per condition") +
  theme(strip.text    = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"))
```

## Overlay — frequency polygons on a common axis

```{r pt-cluster-freqpoly, fig.width=12}
#| fig.height: !expr ceiling(n_lineages / 2) * 3
ggplot(pt_long, aes(x = pseudotime, colour = cluster)) +
  geom_freqpoly(aes(y = after_stat(density)),
                binwidth = 5, linewidth = 0.55, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = scales::hue_pal()(n_cl), name = "Cluster") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  facet_wrap(~ lineage, ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = "Pseudotime (0–100)", y = "Density",
       title = "Cell frequency along pseudotime — per cluster") +
  theme(strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.spacing   = unit(1, "lines"),
        legend.position = "right")
```

# 9  Smooth gene expression along lineages

## Helper function

```{r smooth-expr-fn}
get_smooth_expr_lineage <- function(lins, lin_markers_lst, sling_df, srt,
                                    n_bins = 50, loess_span = 0.75) {
  lin_markers_df <- tibble::enframe(lin_markers_lst,
                                    name  = "clust_marker",
                                    value = "gene_symbol") |>
    tidyr::unnest(cols = gene_symbol)

  traj_long_df <- sling_df[, lins, drop = FALSE] |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-cell_id, names_to = "lins", values_to = "pseudotime") |>
    dplyr::mutate(lins = sub("pseudotime_", "", lins)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(lins) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      pt_norm = (pseudotime - min(pseudotime, na.rm = TRUE)) /
                (max(pseudotime, na.rm = TRUE) - min(pseudotime, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  sct_norm_mat <- Seurat::GetAssayData(srt, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")
  sct_norm_mat <- sct_norm_mat[
    intersect(lin_markers_df$gene_symbol, rownames(sct_norm_mat)), , drop = FALSE]

  sct_long_df <- sct_norm_mat |>
    as.matrix() |> as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_symbol") |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-gene_symbol, names_to = "cell_id", values_to = "sct") |>
    dplyr::left_join(lin_markers_df, by = "gene_symbol")

  dplyr::full_join(traj_long_df, sct_long_df, by = "cell_id",
                   relationship = "many-to-many") |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(pseudotime)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(pt_bin_id = cut(pt_norm, breaks = n_bins,
                                  labels = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(lins, gene_symbol, pt_bin_id, clust_marker) |>
    dplyr::summarise(mean_sct = mean(sct, na.rm = TRUE),
                     pt_norm  = mean(pt_norm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::group_by(lins, gene_symbol) |>
    dplyr::reframe({
      d      <- dplyr::pick(dplyr::everything())
      fit    <- loess(mean_sct ~ pt_norm, data = d, span = loess_span, degree = 1)
      pt_seq <- seq(0, 100, length.out = 100)
      tibble::tibble(pseudotime_bin   = pt_seq,
                     smooth_norm_expr = predict(fit, pt_seq),
                     clust_marker     = dplyr::first(d$clust_marker))
    }) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      clust_marker = factor(clust_marker, levels = names(lin_markers_lst)),
      lineage      = factor(lins, levels = sub("pseudotime_", "", lineage_cols))
    )
}
```

## Helper function — per condition

```{r smooth-expr-cond-fn}
get_smooth_expr_by_condition <- function(lins, lin_markers_lst, sling_df, srt,
                                         condition_col = "condition",
                                         n_bins = 50, loess_span = 0.75) {
  lin_markers_df <- tibble::enframe(lin_markers_lst,
                                    name  = "clust_marker",
                                    value = "gene_symbol") |>
    tidyr::unnest(cols = gene_symbol)

  traj_long_df <- sling_df[, c(lins, condition_col), drop = FALSE] |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::all_of(lins), names_to = "lins", values_to = "pseudotime") |>
    dplyr::mutate(lins = sub("pseudotime_", "", lins)) |>
    dplyr::rename(condition = dplyr::all_of(condition_col)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(lins) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      pt_norm = (pseudotime - min(pseudotime, na.rm = TRUE)) /
                (max(pseudotime, na.rm = TRUE) - min(pseudotime, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  sct_norm_mat <- Seurat::GetAssayData(srt, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")
  sct_norm_mat <- sct_norm_mat[
    intersect(lin_markers_df$gene_symbol, rownames(sct_norm_mat)), , drop = FALSE]

  sct_long_df <- sct_norm_mat |>
    as.matrix() |> as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_symbol") |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-gene_symbol, names_to = "cell_id", values_to = "sct") |>
    dplyr::left_join(lin_markers_df, by = "gene_symbol")

  dplyr::full_join(traj_long_df, sct_long_df, by = "cell_id",
                   relationship = "many-to-many") |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(pseudotime)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(pt_bin_id = cut(pt_norm, breaks = n_bins,
                                  labels = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(lins, gene_symbol, condition, pt_bin_id, clust_marker) |>
    dplyr::summarise(mean_sct = mean(sct, na.rm = TRUE),
                     pt_norm  = mean(pt_norm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::group_by(lins, gene_symbol, condition) |>
    dplyr::reframe({
      d      <- dplyr::pick(dplyr::everything())
      pt_seq <- seq(min(d$pt_norm), max(d$pt_norm), length.out = 100)
      fit    <- loess(mean_sct ~ pt_norm, data = d, span = loess_span, degree = 1)
      tibble::tibble(pseudotime_bin   = pt_seq,
                     smooth_norm_expr = predict(fit, pt_seq),
                     clust_marker     = dplyr::first(d$clust_marker))
    }) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      clust_marker = factor(clust_marker, levels = names(lin_markers_lst)),
      lineage      = factor(lins, levels = sub("pseudotime_", "", lineage_cols))
    )
}
```

  "HSC/Prog" = c("Kit",    "Cd34"),
  "MK"       = c("Itga2b", "Pf4"),

)

)

# 10  Binned expression along trajectories

```{r bin-setup}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))

N_BINS_HM  <- 50L   # pseudotime bins
N_TOP_GENES <- 200L  # HVGs ranked by bin-variance for the overview heatmap
```

```{r bin-compute}
# One genes × n_bins matrix per lineage (raw pseudotime columns from sling_df)
raw_pt_cols <- grep("^Lineage", colnames(slingshot::slingPseudotime(sling_obj)), value = TRUE)

bin_mats <- setNames(
  lapply(raw_pt_cols, function(lc) {
    cat("Binning", lc, "...\n")
    bin_expr_along_pseudotime(
      srt         = mpn_processed_hsc,
      sling_df    = as.data.frame(slingshot::slingPseudotime(sling_obj)),
      lineage_col = lc,
      n_bins      = N_BINS_HM,
      assay       = "SCT",
      layer       = "data",
      smooth      = TRUE,
      smooth_span = 0.3
    )
  }),
  raw_pt_cols
)

cat("Bin matrices computed:\n")
for (nm in names(bin_mats))
  cat(" ", nm, "—", nrow(bin_mats[[nm]]), "genes ×", ncol(bin_mats[[nm]]), "bins\n")
```

## Top HVGs — all lineages side by side

Genes ordered by peak pseudotime bin in Lineage1 (expression wave ordering).
Colour = z-score per gene across bins; shared scale across panels.

```{r bin-heatmap-top, fig.width=5}
#| fig.height: !expr min(20, ceiling(N_TOP_GENES / 8))
ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  plot_lineage_heatmap(bin_mats,
                        n_top      = N_TOP_GENES,
                        gene_order = "peak",
                        scale      = TRUE),
  merge_legend = TRUE
)
```

## Marker genes — ordered expression

```{r bin-heatmap-markers, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
marker_genes <- c(
  "Kit", "Cd34", "Slamf1",          # HSC/progenitor
  "Itga2b", "Pf4", "Vwf", "Gp1bb",  # MK
  "Hba-a1", "Epor", "Gata1",         # Ery
  "Mpo", "Elane", "Cebpa"            # Myeloid
)

ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  plot_lineage_heatmap(bin_mats,
                        genes      = marker_genes,
                        gene_order = marker_genes,
                        scale      = TRUE,
                        show_row_names = TRUE),
  merge_legend = TRUE
)
```
